# Day 4 — Calculus / Mission

Math covers integration and area under the curve, limits, and
differentiation — first learning to *read* $\int$, $\lim$, and
$\dfrac{dy}{dx}$, then computing them in the order the math builds, with
each tool tied back to Day 3's PDFs, CDFs, and expectation. Programming
— **Mission** — covers housekeeping (working directories, importing and
exporting datasets, packages, YAML, code chunks), data wrangling with
dplyr and tidyr, and the grammar of graphics with ggplot.

This session has two parts:

- **[Math Session](slides.qmd)** — the in-class slideshow.
- **[Programming Session](programming.qmd)** — a webpage walking through the
  same material with runnable R code.
